content.intro: This lesson introduces lazy evaluation and memory efficiency as part of iterables, iterators, comprehensions, and generators. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: Iterables offer a consistent way to consume data. Lazy processing can reduce peak memory, while eager collections are convenient when values must be revisited.
